body:
Set and Setting:
Starting at home with my girlfriend, intentions of going for a walk and see the thrift store, after that we hadn't really made plans. Mindset was good, eager to learn about a new (to me) substance. I'm quite experienced with psychedelics and was looking for a mild experience to test the waters with this new compound, and to be sure I wouldn't be in for too intense of an experience for up to 16hrs. Read up a lot on this compound, so was expecting some nausea in the comeup, slightly nervous for that.
I decided to take this compound early in the day, so at 11:00 I took the tablet containing 25mg of aMT. This stuff apparently lasts super long, and to have a chance of a good nights sleep its important to start early. Or so I have read.
T+00:20 First alert, slight nausea and difficult to place stimulation.
T+01:30 Visual perception definitely altered, low dose acid like increased contrast, edges, colours, but nothing crazy.
Enhanced energy and mood walking around the city.
T+02:11 Slight headache but probably little dehydrated. Effects havent seemed to intensify, headspace seems more slowed than sped up as opposed to more stimulating psychs or amphetamines.
T+03:30 Pretty much stable effects for an hour, pupils seem to have dilated more since last check in, visual field a bit blurry/washed, slightly teary eyes, still enhanced contrast texture color type stuff. Warm floaty body high, still slight headache. Nausea barely there, a little bit of this type of throaty nausea I also get on LSD. We went to a thrift store and looked around at some stuff, but it was quite busy being a sunday afternoon, and there wasnt really anything interesting, so we didnt stay long. On most psychedelics I'd feel weird and anxious being in a busy store, but with aMT, I had no trouble at all. My pupils were pretty dilated at this time but I didn't really mind if anyone saw :')
T+05:00-07:00 Got home from the walk, played some video games and ate a little something. Around here I'd say the effects peaked, very immersed in the game and quite enhanced/shifted focus on things like animations, plants, animals in the game.
Nausea from here on is pretty much gone, however the slight headache stayed lingering for the whole evening.
T+07:00 - 12:00 Went to my friends' studio space to hang out and play more video games - somewhere around the 07:00 mark my roommate woke up (after a night shift) and I chatted for a bit, she was surprised to hear I was tripping because I didn't seem inebriated at all, apart from my dilated pupils. I didn't really feel very 'high' either. The whole experience was very subtle all the way through, really.
The whole experience was very subtle all the way through, really.
T+12:00 In the evening I smoked some weed. Visual effects were pretty much gone at this point, and there was some residual stimulation, and I didnt feel much of the weed even though I smoked a higher dose than I'd normally do, cbn hash+indica did put me to sleep tho, just didnt feel like the thc got me very stoned. I've seen other people report this online, seems like other stim/entactogens have a similar effect, on mdma I can also smoke as much weed as I like and not get nearly as stoned as I would normally.
It took me a while to get to sleep, ended up sleeping at around T+16:00. Next day I dont feel hungover or in a bad mood, other than having slept not too much, but otherwise I feel quite good.
To summarize the effects: long, mellow comeup with some nausea and weird trypty stimulation, which subsides around two hours in. From there it feels like 50ug of LSD's visual enhancement, very subtle mdma-like, warm body high and a constant stimulation with some very faint jaw tension. Head high I would describe as 'softly euphoric', not a forced 'I love everyone' high, but a nice and clearly noticable mood booster, akin to kratom.
I quite like this stuff, though next time I would see if there's any precautions I could take to mitigate the headache. It's a very subtle high, slow comeup, very soft comedown. No crash, but a smooth landing.
I would like to see how far the psychedelia can be intensified with higher dosing, but I wouldn't do that without being sure(ish) that I can get rid of the headache.
AMT is an MAOI, and I sort of watched my diet the week before but not super rigourously. I guess that could be a reason for the headache.
